name: Bunny Date: Carrots
source:
After moving to the city at the advice of your childhood friend, Felicity, you find yourself in a new busy place unlike the countryside you're used to. Will you stay on the straight and narrow path or will you be tempted into the shadowy underworld?  


When the decision has to be made, will you stay in the city or give up and go back  home to the farm?


You can make friends, or enemies, find romance with a cast of available characters, you guide your own path through the story.

[edited from [url=https://lunarrabbitfish.itch.io/bunny-date-carrots-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在儿时好友费莉西蒂的建议下搬到城市后，你发现自己身处一个新的繁忙的地方，与你习惯的乡村不同。你会继续走在笔直狭窄的道路上，还是会被诱惑进入阴暗的地下世界？


当必须做出决定时，你是留在城市还是放弃回到农场？


你可以结交朋友或敌人，与一群可用的角色寻找浪漫，在故事中引导你自己的道路。

[编辑自[url=https://lunarrabbitfish.itch.io/bunny-date-carrots-demo]itch.io[/url]]
